overlays.upstream: The `name` field is required in the `BTDocumentParams` schema when creating a new document.
overlays.value: The `name` field is semantically required and must be nonempty when creating a document, although `BTDocumentParams` does not mark it OpenAPI-required. `parentId` accepts the destination folder's opaque ID, not its name or path. Free accounts require `isPublic=true`. Omit ownership, project, debug/internal, and null optional fields unless deliberately needed; clients must not assume OpenAPI defaults are applied.

overlays.upstream: See the [Configuration API Guide](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/configs/) for additional details
overlays.value: See the [Configuration API Guide](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/configs/) for additional details. `nodeId` is opaque server-owned identity: omit it on newly authored configuration parameters, options, and current-configuration entries; read the configuration back and preserve exact server-returned IDs in later updates. Never synthesize IDs from names, UUIDs, or inferred formats.

overlays.upstream: Document ID of this document's parent.
overlays.value: Opaque ID of this document's parent folder. Supply the folder ID, not its name or path.

Opaque server-owned BTObjectId for serialized node identity. Preserve an exact ID returned by Onshape for later updates; never synthesize one from a name, UUID, or inferred format. Omit it for newly authored configuration nodes.
